messages:
kai: Heads-up — we’re doing a small catalog enable for quant-v2 variants in the early change window (02:00-04:00 UTC). Canary at 1% traffic, then staged 5%/20%/100%. fallback ordering needs to be explicit: quant-v2 -> quant-v1 -> float32.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: 02:12 UTC; canary id=cb-3319; executor=deploy-bot.

mira: Added latency/p95 guard at +15ms over baseline (5m window) and an error-rate abort at >=0.5% for 10m. Also spinning up a per-model error heatmap dash.

sam: Rollback thresholds confirmed: any sustained p95 +30ms OR error-rate >=1% for 5m triggers an immediate rollback call. I’ll take ownership of the rollback decision.

ana: Release notes updated with the model changes and the mitigations. Notifying CS and SRE runbooks.\/cc @product-security for data-handling note.

kai: Important: enterprise tenants should stay pinned to titan-1 for 24h by default — we’ll do a manual pin for accounts in the enterprise tag. That avoids noisy customer exposure.

mira: Deploy step: catalog:update --enable quant-v2 --canary 1% --fallback-seq quant-v2,quant-v1,float32  (I’ll run it when the window opens). Ensure the sequencer prioritizes quant fallbacks to avoid memory spikes.

deploy-bot: ack: will apply fallback sequence on canary and propagate to canary-only routing.

kai: Observability plan: watch p50/p95/p99, token throughput, KV-cache hit-rate, and degen rate on responses. If KV cache misses spike >10% we pause rollout.

mira: early telemetry note: first 1000 canary requests show p95 +3ms, KV-hit stable. :eyes:

sam: Good sign. Keep an eye on hallucination/quality evals — run the standard prompt set every 15m and post summary. If quality regressions >3% on the eval set, we stop.

kai: I’ll post lightweight summaries here (latency, errors, eval delta) every check interval. If anyone sees anything urgent react with :rotating_light: and we escalate.

mira: If we need a forced rollback: deploy-bot rollback cb-3319 --reason "threshold breach". Sam will coordinate customer comms if needed.

ana: Also added a short blurb to the status page in case we need to post an incident-facing note.

kai: OK starting the canary in ~5m. Will ping with timestamps and a 5m/15m check-in.

deploy-bot: canary started at 02:12:20 UTC — cb-3319 now routing 1% traffic to quant-v2.

mira: 02:17 UTC check: p95 +4ms, errors 0.08%, eval-run 1/10 checks done (no regression).

sam: Green from me for ramp to 5%. Proceed when you are ready.

kai: ramping to 5% now. Will monitor closely.

mira: 02:28 UTC: p95 +9ms but within guard. KV-hit stable. No quality flags.

kai: continuing to 20% in 20m if we stay green. Thanks all — will update after the 30m check-in.
